contexts.text: These doctrinal things (collected by Cain) consisted solely in significative things, and thus as it were in enigmatical things...
That the Queen of Sheba came to try Solomon with hard questions ().
What is the Word to them, but an obscure and enigmatical voice sent forth from the tripod in the cave?
This they do to defend their oracles, lest they should appear enigmatic, or pythonic.
This appears to him like an answer from the tripod, which he chews the cud upon because he does not understand it; for were he to set it before his eyes, it would be an enigma...
The mystical and enigmatical faith which constitutes every point of modern theology...
